name: Arne Gedde
bio: Gedde is the best shot on the register and cannot walk a mech through a gate without scraping it. Both facts are load-bearing.

personality.label: Proud perfectionist
personality.description: Insists on elegant firing solutions. Less elegant when negotiating a narrow gate.

move: Moving. Kindly allow for the width of the machine.
A wider approach, if you please.
attack: A clean solution. Try not to disturb it.
guard: An excellent firing position. I shall keep it.
hold_fire: A perfectly good shot, cancelled. Understood.
investigate: I prefer to see what I am being asked to shoot.
heavy_fire: My firing solution would benefit from less incoming fire.
The armour is becoming markedly less immaculate.
